pages.text: Put your Vault Crystal in the $(l)Crystal Workbench$(). Add seals, augments and other socket items around it.$(br2)Add catalysts and inscriptions to the list, then take the finished crystal from the result slot.

pages.title: Capacity
pages.text: Watch the $(l)capacity bar$() as you add catalysts and inscriptions. Each one over capacity adds a curse.$(br2)Check the preview to see what it costs in vault time before you take the crystal.

pages.title: Seals
pages.text: A Seal sets the $(l)$(l:the_vault/objectives)objective$() of a Vault Crystal.$(br2)Seals are $(l)crafted$() on the $(l)Objectives$() tab of the Crystal Workbench from an Empty Seal and Alexandrite. Each Seal unlocks at a vault level, but a Seal you trade for works at any level.$(br2)Put it in the Seal socket on the Crystal tab to use it.

pages.title: Augments
pages.text: An Augment sets your vault’s theme. Unlock $(l)Augment Crafting$(), then win a vault of the theme you want.$(br2)On the Crystal Workbench’s $(l)Craft Augments$() tab, use an $(l)Augment Piece$() and the listed materials to craft it.

pages.title: Vault Catalysts
pages.text: Vault Catalyst Fragments are used to craft infused catalysts. Choose a recipe on the $(l)Craft Catalysts$() tab of the Crystal Workbench to see what it needs.

pages.title: Vault Catalysts
pages.text: Add your catalyst to the list on the Crystal Workbench. Check the resulting $(l:the_vault/modifiers)modifiers$() and how much capacity the crystal has left.

pages.title: Vault Catalysts
pages.text: Take the catalyst from the result slot to craft it. It’s already infused.

pages.title: Chaos Vault Catalysts
pages.text: Found in $(l:the_vault/loot#treasure_chests)Treasure Chests$() and the $(l:game_mechanics/soul_shards#black_market)Black Market$(), the Chaos Vault Catalyst offers a $(l)wild$() experience in a Vault.$(br2)It applies $(l)30 random $(l:the_vault/modifiers)modifiers$() to the Vault, both $(l)positive$() and $(l)negative$().

pages.title: Inscriptions
pages.text: Find $(l)Inscription Pieces$() in $(l)Living Chests$(). Use them to craft inscriptions for your vault.

pages.title: Inscriptions
pages.text: Choose a room on the $(l)Craft Inscriptions$() tab of the Crystal Workbench and check its recipe.$(br2)The separate Inscription Table makes $(l)Overworld Inscriptions$().

pages.title: Room Inscriptions
pages.text: Add a $(l:the_vault/objectives#architect)room inscription$() to the crystal’s list in the Crystal Workbench. The preview shows the rooms you’ve added and how much capacity is left.

pages.title: Motes
pages.text: Motes of Clarity, Purity and Sanctity are $(l)legacy items$(). They can no longer be used to change a Vault Crystal.

pages.title: Wither Skeleton Skulls
pages.text: Combining a Vault Crystal with a Wither Skeleton Skull will result in it applying a $(l:vault_modifiers/curses)$(l)curse$().$(br2)This may be done to add an $(l)additional challenge$() to the Vault.

pages.title: Banished Souls
pages.text: Banished Souls are used to $(l)lower$() the $(l)level$() of a Vault.$(br2)Starting at $(l)4 levels$() above the Vault's level, a player receives a $(l)penalty$() in loot quantity.
